scope: Read-only review of the frozen CIXPROJ1 adapter, fixed projection recipes, CIXV1 mode-5/JXL path, runtime identity, cached PAQ controls, and terminal receipts available at audit time. No encoder or decoder was rerun.
audit_history: Initial read-only cutoff preceded the offset-400MiB terminals. This amendment uses the same frozen f9b5ffd source and adds those completed physical archives; no archive was decoded during either audit pass.

format_review.evidence: Each recipe frames the entire supplied byte string with its exact source length. The outer frame stores original and projected lengths. Decode checks dimensions, crops only paid zero raster padding, rejects values above 255, restores the projection, and checks restored source length.

P1/P3 frame the BWT primary index and source length. P1 stores all eight packed planes and derives their exact padded width from paid n. P3 serializes eight zero counts and eight packed levels. P2 declares primary=0 and has no BWT. All projection frame bytes feed the inner CIXV1 payload.

Every CIXPROJ1 archive rehashed here conserves total = 29-byte header + 37-byte fixed metadata + complete CIXV1 inner frame. The inner parser validated CIXV1 mode 5, raster dimensions, metadata length and JXL payload length.

format_review.check: hidden state, dictionaries, selection or PAQ fallback
format_review.evidence: The fixed adapter has no detector or selector and invokes only the projection transform then volume_image_codec mode 5. Manifests declare PAQ fallback FORBIDDEN; probe source has no PAQ invocation. P2 starts 257 byte-order rank lists locally per frame. No external dictionary/model is supplied.

The current frozen source hashes match freeze.json. Terminal build identities include the frozen projection, adapter, volume codec, runtime-manifest and CIX dependencies. Native completed receipts prove the runtime manifest check passed at encode and decode.

Each real projection manifest gates against a completed, VERIFIED_SCREENING original-byte PAQ v216 -4 AVX2 archive with matching input, PAQ binary hash/options and candidate.source.bin policy. The gate rehashes its control archive and restored output before candidate encode. Controls are size references only, not fresh timing comparisons.

synthetic_correctness.interpretation: These establish adapter/recipe round-trip correctness on one deterministic fixture only. They are not PAQ comparisons and do not predict real Wikipedia compression.

observed_physical_details.inner_path: CIXV1 mode 5 -> lossless JPEG XL effort 9 single thread

limitations: All six real archives are complete physical observations but intentionally reconstruction-unverified because each was already larger than its independently verified PAQ control. They cannot be promoted.

The current static audit cannot prove the native JXL implementation has no undiscovered library defect; the frozen runtime manifest and completed archive-only synthetic decodes are the available evidence.
There is no holdout result, larger-scale result, full-enwik9 result, Hutter package size, score or eligibility from this audit.
CIXV1/JXL runtime inventory is pinned for reproducibility but has not been reduced to a Hutter submission package.
